name: Palak Tofu
steps: Blanch washed spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, then plunge into cold water and drain. Blend with green chili and 60 ml water to a smooth green puree.
Press and cube tofu; pat dry. Heat 15 ml oil and sear tofu for 2 minutes per side until light gold; remove.
Heat remaining oil and sizzle cumin. Fry onion for 7 minutes, add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute, then tomato and 5 g salt; cook 6 minutes until soft.
Add spinach puree and remaining water. Simmer uncovered for 4–5 minutes, stirring, but avoid a long boil so the green remains bright.
Fold in tofu, garam masala and remaining salt. Warm gently for 3 minutes and serve with roti.
tips: Cool blanched spinach promptly to preserve its green colour; add tofu near the end.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
